# This is not about being "against technology"; it is about being "against dependency"

## Position
### Not rejecting technology
### Not leaving platforms
### Against relying on a single support

## Core idea
### An external channel is not under your control
### You cannot put everything in one place
### You need your own foundation

## The role of your own foundation
### It complements working channels
### It reduces dependency
### It creates an exit option
### It restores control

## The limitations of a messenger
### A communication channel
### Not a business archive
### No service structure
### No transferable base

## The role of a platform
### It brings clients
### The rules change
### It takes over part of the relationship
#### Through the interface
#### Through the data

## Approach to change
### Fear of migration is justified
### Abrupt transfers are risky
### First preserve the flow
### Then build a new base

## Key conclusion
### A foundation as insurance
### The platform and your own environment
### The client relationship remains with you
